export const B=n=>Array.from({length:n},(_,i)=>`${i+1}`).join(''); export const IM=""; // [emoji, properties, html, solution, ar, fr, en, flags, starter] export const BASE=[ ["","margin · padding · border · border-radius",B(3),"b{margin:14px;padding:12px;border:3px solid #333;border-radius:10px}", "لكل مربع (b): هامش 14px، حشو 12px، حد صلب 3px بلون #333، وحواف مستديرة 10px","Pour chaque boîte (b) : marge 14px, padding 12px, bordure 3px solid #333, rayon 10px","Each box (b): margin 14px, padding 12px, 3px solid #333 border, 10px radius"], ["","width · height · max-width · min-height · box-sizing",B(1),"#p{width:80%;max-width:240px;min-height:100px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:20px}", "للحاوية: عرض 80%، أقصى عرض 240px، أدنى ارتفاع 100px، حشو 20px، وbox-sizing: border-box","Conteneur : largeur 80 %, max-width 240px, min-height 100px, padding 20px, border-box","Container: width 80%, max-width 240px, min-height 100px, padding 20px, border-box"], ["","color · background · font-family · font-size · font-weight · line-height · text-align · text-decoration","Hello CSS","#p{color:#fff;background:#14532d;font-family:serif;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.8;text-align:center;text-decoration:underline}", "للحاوية: نص أبيض، خلفية #14532d، خط serif بحجم 20px وسُمك 700، ارتفاع سطر 1.8، توسيط وتسطير","Conteneur : texte blanc, fond #14532d, serif 20px gras 700, interligne 1.8, centré, souligné","Container: white text, #14532d background, serif 20px weight 700, line-height 1.8, centered, underlined"], ["","px · rem · em · %",B(2),"b{font-size:1.5rem;padding:.5em 1em;width:50%}", "لكل مربع: حجم خط 1.5rem، حشو 0.5em 1em، وعرض 50%","Chaque boîte : font-size 1.5rem, padding .5em 1em, largeur 50 %","Each box: font-size 1.5rem, padding .5em 1em, width 50%"], ["","display",B(4),"b{display:block;width:90px;text-align:center} b:last-child{display:none}", "اجعل المربعات block بعرض 90px ونص في المنتصف، وأخفِ الأخير","Boîtes en block, 90px, texte centré ; masquez la dernière","Make boxes block, 90px wide, centered text; hide the last one"], ["","flex-direction · justify-content · align-items · gap",B(3),"#p{display:flex;flex-direction:row-reverse;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:10px}", "حوّل الحاوية إلى flex بعكس الاتجاه، توزيع space-between، توسيط عمودي، وفجوة 10px","Flex inversé (row-reverse), space-between, centré verticalement, gap 10px","Flex container reversed (row-reverse), space-between, vertically centered, gap 10px"], ["","flex-wrap · flex · order · align-self",B(5),"#p{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px} b{flex:1 1 40%} b:first-child{order:3;align-self:flex-end}", "flex مع التفاف وفجوة 8px؛ كل مربع flex: 1 1 40%؛ والأول order: 3 و align-self: flex-end","Flex avec wrap, gap 8px ; chaque boîte flex 1 1 40 % ; la première order 3 et align-self flex-end","Flex with wrap and 8px gap; each box flex 1 1 40%; the first one order 3 and align-self flex-end"], ["","grid-template-columns · grid-template-rows · gap · fr",B(6),"#p{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 2fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:50px 50px;gap:10px}", "grid بثلاثة أعمدة 1fr 2fr 1fr وصفّين 50px وفجوة 10px","Grid 3 colonnes 1fr 2fr 1fr, 2 lignes de 50px, gap 10px","Grid with 3 columns 1fr 2fr 1fr, two 50px rows, 10px gap"], ["","repeat() · minmax() · auto-fit · grid-area · place-items",B(6),"#p{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(90px,1fr));gap:8px;place-items:center} b:first-child{grid-area:1/1/2/3}", "شبكة متجاوبة repeat(auto-fit,minmax(90px,1fr)) بفجوة 8px وتوسيط place-items؛ والأول grid-area: 1/1/2/3","Grille repeat(auto-fit,minmax(90px,1fr)), gap 8px, place-items center ; la première grid-area 1/1/2/3","Responsive grid repeat(auto-fit,minmax(90px,1fr)), 8px gap, place-items center; first box grid-area 1/1/2/3"], ["","position · top/right · z-index",`

Badge s : absolute en haut à droite à -10px, z-index 2","Card .c: relative, margin 20px, height 70px, #ddd background. boîtes : ombre 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4), opacité .8, curseur pointer","Container overflow hidden; boxes: shadow 0 4px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.4), opacity .8, pointer cursor"], ["","transition",B(2),"b{transition:all .3s ease-in-out}", "أضف انتقالاً للمربعات على كل الخصائص: 0.3 ثانية وتسارع ease-in-out (ثم مرّر الماوس عليها)","Transition sur toutes les propriétés : 0.3s ease-in-out (puis survolez les boîtes)","Add a transition on all properties: 0.3s ease-in-out (then hover the boxes)"], ["","transform: rotate · scale · translate",B(3),"b{transform:rotate(10deg) scale(1.2) translateX(8px)}", "لكل مربع: تدوير 10deg ثم تكبير 1.2 ثم إزاحة أفقية 8px (بهذا الترتيب)","Chaque boîte : rotate 10deg, scale 1.2, puis translateX 8px (dans cet ordre)","Each box: rotate 10deg, then scale 1.2, then translateX 8px (in this order)",0], ["","animation · @keyframes · prefers-reduced-motion",B(3),"b{animation:spin 2s linear infinite}", "طبّق الحركة الجاهزة spin: مدة 2s، خطية، تتكرر للأبد","Appliquez l’animation spin : 2s, linéaire, infinie","Apply the ready-made spin animation: 2s, linear, infinite","nr"], ["","@media (min-width)",B(3),"@media (min-width:320px){b{background:#16a34a;width:60%}}", "داخل @media (min-width:320px): خلفية المربعات #16a34a وعرضها 60%","Dans @media (min-width:320px) : fond #16a34a et largeur 60 %","Inside @media (min-width:320px): boxes get #16a34a background and 60% width"], ["","vw · vh · svh · dvh",B(1),"#p{height:25svh;width:60vw}", "الحاوية: ارتفاع 25svh وعرض 60vw","Conteneur : hauteur 25svh, largeur 60vw","Container: height 25svh, width 60vw"], ["","clamp() · min() · max()",B(2),"#p{width:clamp(180px,60%,320px)} b{font-size:clamp(14px,4vw,22px)}", "عرض الحاوية clamp(180px,60%,320px)، وخط المربعات clamp(14px,4vw,22px)","Largeur clamp(180px,60%,320px), police des boîtes clamp(14px,4vw,22px)","Container width clamp(180px,60%,320px); box font-size clamp(14px,4vw,22px)"], ["","var() · --variables",B(3),"#p{--c:#22c55e;--r:12px} b{background:var(--c);border-radius:var(--r)}", "عرّف --c:#22c55e و --r:12px على الحاوية، واستخدمهما في خلفية المربعات وحوافها","Définissez --c:#22c55e et --r:12px puis utilisez-les pour le fond et le rayon","Define --c:#22c55e and --r:12px, then use them for background and radius"], ["","aspect-ratio · object-fit",IM+IM,"img{width:100px;aspect-ratio:1;object-fit:cover}", "اجعل الصور مربعة بعرض 100px بدون تشويه (aspect-ratio و object-fit: cover)","Images carrées de 100px sans déformation (aspect-ratio, object-fit cover)","Make images 100px squares without distortion (aspect-ratio, object-fit cover)"], ["",":has() · :is() · :where()",`
